title: Federated Learning, Trusted Third-Party Custody & Differential Privacy
text: dicomtk.fl enables multi-institutional imaging consortia collaborate without centralising patient-level DICOM clinical identifiers: Trusted Third-Party (TTP) & Polymorphic Pseudonymisation (PEP): ttp_mainzelliste_client, pep_derive_site_token(), pep_rekey_pseudonym() issue unlinkable project- site-specific pseudonyms. Privacy-Preserving Record Linkage (PPRL): pprl_encode_bloom(), pprl_dice_similarity(), pprl_link_cohorts() match patients across hospitals using frequency-hardened Bloom filters. Differential Privacy (DP) Federated Statistics: dp_budget_accountant, dp_suppress_small_cells(), dp_federated_summary(), dp_aggregate_sites() release bounded (ε,δ)(\varepsilon, \delta)-DP cohort summaries enforcing kk-anonymity. Governed FL Site Package Exports: fl_site_approval_gate fl_export_site_package() require cryptographic site_admin sign-emitting Flower, NVIDIA FLARE, OpenFL bundles.
code: library(dicomtk.fl)  # 1. TTP + Polymorphic Pseudonymisation ttp <- ttp_mainzelliste_client$new(mode = "offline", ttp_secret = "demo-secret") sess <- ttp$create_session() root_id <- ttp$request_pseudonym(   sess$session_id,   list(vorname = "Alice", nachname = "Tan", geburtsdatum = "1985-04-12") ) tok_a <- pep_derive_site_token(root_id$pid, "PROJ_A", "SITE_1", "pep-key") tok_b <- pep_rekey_pseudonym(tok_a, "PROJ_B", "SITE_2", "pep-key") tok_a$pseudonym != tok_b$pseudonym #> [1] TRUE  # 2. DP Federated Summary acc <- dp_budget_accountant$new(max_epsilon = 3.0, max_delta = 1e-5) set.seed(1) s1 <- dp_federated_summary(rnorm(120, 62, 8), lower = 0, upper = 120, accountant = acc, site_id = "SITE_1") s2 <- dp_federated_summary(rnorm(150, 65, 8), lower = 0, upper = 120, accountant = acc, site_id = "SITE_2") dp_aggregate_sites(list(s1, s2)) #> $n_sites #> [1] 2 #>  #> $site_ids #> [1] "SITE_1" "SITE_2" #>  #> $total_count #> [1] 263.4791 #>  #> $weighted_mean #> [1] 81.20886
